items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: They had the Peters Sisters and Bonnie Baker was with Tommy Tucker...

ctx.x: Do you remember the name of the Ball-Room? Was it the Million Dollar Ball-Room?...

They burned the Pid-mor Ball-Room down. They burned it down including Mr. Charlie Barnet's instruments and all of his music because they did not want a black band to play out there where Benny Goodman had got his big smash out there. When we were playing in the Oakland Ball-Room, we came into Los Angeles, we did 18 days down in the theatre and they took us and we played the World's Fair up in San Francisco on Treasure Island. They had the Peters Sisters and Bonnie Baker was with Tommy Tucker... They burned the…
That's the Pid-mor and now we're in 'Frisco, at The World's Fair. That wasn't where they burned it down.
